noise_contract.definition: Independent zero-mean Gaussian per circuit/channel/time; sigma=level*clean-train RMS, including DC.
noise_contract.rng: NumPy PCG64(SeedSequence([root, domain, level_index, realization])); float32 standard_normal in C order (circuit,channel,time).
noise_contract.order: CSV split order, recorded batch size; reset bank stream for every model/validation epoch. Zero level consumes no noise.
noise_contract.augmentation: Separate from torch shuffle RNG; choose one level uniformly per circuit each epoch, then fresh float32 normals for entire batch.
noise_contract.hash: SHA256 of concatenated C-order float32 physical perturbation batches per condition; batch size and NumPy version are part of contract.

selection: Both paired controls selected on equal-average fixed-bank MSE across all levels.
caveat: Realizations are repeated measurements of the same circuits, not independent circuits. MPS bitwise training reproducibility is not guaranteed.
